name: MCDMA
description: Configure and verify RDMA links between supported Mac and Linux hosts for distributed local inference.
compatibility: TensorFold distributed inference; supported Thunderbolt and Linux RDMA fabrics.
limitations: Requires qualified hardware, cables, adapters, and drivers; hardware tags do not imply every cross-platform link is validated.
The documented Strix Halo/Mac workflow still needs physical validation.

sources.note: Upstream description, setup, and documented requirements.
